prompt: Use case: compositing. Assemble ONE finished square transparent-background national-focus icon for the A-Discord strategy game focus 'Reactor Sorties' from exactly these TWO supplied assets. Image 1 is the gas-mask rifleman: preserve his distinctive domed brimmed helmet, round mask eyepieces, cylindrical respirator filter, khaki patchwork long coat, webbing, gloved hands and complete diagonal wood-and-steel rifle. Image 2 is the zero-point reactor: preserve its tall faceted armored tower, long vertical open slit with brilliant blue energy column and stacked containment collars, splayed buttresses and industrial base. Layout: foreground LEFT a large readable rifleman cropped intentionally at mid-thigh, his helmet near the upper left and both hands and the FULL rifle intact, rifle barrel sloping downward toward lower right. Background RIGHT the reactor, its entire tower crown and bright blue core clearly visible beside the soldier's right shoulder, its base making the bottom-right of the composition. Use symbolic focus-icon scale, not realistic person-to-building scale. Rifleman occupies roughly the left half of the icon and reactor the right half, modest overlap to form a compact balanced square silhouette; reactor crown can rise slightly above soldier helmet. Preserve the source paintings and their recognizable designs, do not reinvent a different soldier or building. Unify finish as a realistic hand-painted HOI4 focus collage: dark charcoal exterior outline with subtle warm brown edge shading, firm silhouette, warm muted bronze and khaki surfaces contrasted with a contained cyan core. A faint cool reflection on the reactor-facing edge of the coat is sufficient, no bright neon outer rim. Make mask, weapon and cyan core easy to read at 150x150 icon display size. No background rectangle, landscape, sky, smoke cloud, floor, added radiation symbol, ring frame, gear emblem, text, lettering, flags, medals, banners, extra characters, extra buildings or new props. Genuine alpha transparency outside the assembled silhouette, transparent gaps where appropriate, narrow clear padding so the rifle and reactor are not clipped. Deliver one compact finished icon, not a sheet, retain complete hands and weapon.
